title: Erasmus+ Project in Rethymno
text: From June 3rd to July 2nd, 2025, I lived for a month on the island of Crete. An immersive experience aimed at developing system, linguistic, and interpersonal skills in a multicultural context.

popupSections.title: Arrival and Cultural Immersion
popupSections.text: My adventure in Rethymno officially began on June 3rd. The impact of the city was exciting: I had to adapt quickly to a new culture and unprecedented rhythms of life. From the very first day, communicating exclusively in English became the norm, turning initial logistical challenges into an extraordinary opportunity for independence.

popupSections.title: Internship at the Institute of Mediterranean Studies
popupSections.text: The core of the experience was the operational internship at IMS, an innovative local IT company. Working closely with their developers, I got hands-on experience with real projects: I configured Linux-based environments, managed container architectures, and wrote scripts for business process automation. It was my true field test in an international IT team.

popupSections.title: Networking, Friendships, and Growth
popupSections.text: Beyond the technical skills, this month in Greece left me with invaluable human experience. I formed strong bonds of friendship with colleagues and other international students. Exploring the island in my free time, collaborating, and overcoming obstacles together boosted my empathy and expanded my network, making me much more confident and proactive toward the future.

title: Accenture S.p.A.
text: Training course carried out entirely at school as a Simulated Training Enterprise. The activity focused on the study and practical application of frontend web development, delving into JavaScript and the use of frameworks like Angular and Bootstrap.

title: IBM Italia Spa
text: Two-year activity carried out mainly in the classroom. Specialized technical training in the IT field with a global leader in the sector.

title: Apulia Makers 3D
text: Practical work-environment activity focused on 3D modeling and printing technologies at a specialized company in Puglia.

title: ANFOS - Online Safety
text: Training module delivered online focused on safety in the workplace and IT security.

title: Social Innovation and Content
text: Guided activities at Next Level ETS and Fondazione Megamark Onlus in the non-profit sector, and Campus Editori Srl in editorial production.

title: Future Choice Paths
text: Visits and orientation activities with Polytechnic of Bari, SSML Bona Sforza, Orienta Puglia, and eCampus. Days of contact with academic institutions, even distant ones, for an informed choice.

title: Auriga S.P.A.
text: On-site activity at a tech company specialized in advanced software solutions for the banking sector and ATM infrastructure.

title: Orientation and Local Networks
text: Inclusion of corporate and institutional modules to consolidate contacts with the entire industrial and national innovation ecosystem.
